steps.content: The night's performance begins on schedule. Sallie manages to get through the first show, her nerves taut.

During the intermission, she doesn't follow the others backstage. Instead, she slips into a bathroom stall and retrieves the communicator, which she'd wrapped in plastic and hidden in the toilet tank.
After a quick check to ensure it's dry, she tucks it into her costume and walks out of the bathroom, trying to look composed.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: There has to be a way. First, I need to contact the outside world...
A large hand clamps around Sallie's waist, trapping her. A cloth, soaked in some strange chemical, is pressed against her mouth and nose.
No chance to scream, no time to struggle. Sallie's head spins, and the world goes black.
